intro: Technology, government, and cybersecurity sectors bore the brunt of 52 articles tagged with ai-security between April 12 and May 1, 2026, with 24 high and 7 critical severity reports. Threat actors Claude Mythos and OpenClaw were observed, while vulnerabilities CVE-2026-5760 (CVSS 9.8) and CVE-2026-5752 (CVSS 9.3) posed significant risks globally, particularly across China and the United States. The coverage also touched on healthcare and artificial intelligence sectors, with 6 medium and 12 informational items rounding out the mix.
